Established in October 2015 by the Viet Deli Group, their 'Home' concept of restaurants, which includes Home Hanoi Restaurant, serves authentic Vietnamese regional dishes, featuring fresh ingredients and traditional recipes presented in modern contemporary fashion, with exquisite service in locales that feature quaint refined charming ambience.
.
Ambience at Home Hanoi Restaurant exudes a quiet and refined elegance. The vibrant yet sophisticated yellow-walled French style villa features a welcoming walkway framed with a green arch, opening into a private courtyard lit by ample natural light and ornate lanterns. Within, the sturdy furnishings are laid with elegant silverware, graced with larger-than-life vintage photos on the wall, warmly lit and cozy.
.
Service at Home Hanoi Restaurant is professional and courteous. Staff welcome guests at the walkway, and accompany them to their seating area of choice, ushering them with grace. They patiently describe the ala-carte buffet concept, and introduce dishes as they serve. I note staff are relatively young but well educated, nearly all being able to converse decently in English. They proactively offer to refresh drinks, and clear away finished plates, cleaning up quickly. Had a fantastic dining experience, my thanks to Huy, Thuong, and Huyen, for the great service!
.
Food at Home Hanoi Restaurant is traditional, authentic Vietnamese cuisine, presented in modern contemporary fashion. This allows diners, particularly tourists, to sample a wide range of local dishes, through their ala-carte buffet for both lunch and dinner (you can order an unlimited number of dishes for only 1 price). Portions are sized according to number of diners. Prices are steep, thanks to the high quality of food, premium ingredients, sophisticated ambience, and friendly service. Budget about VND ₫912,000 / SGD $52 per person.
